response.sql: SELECT P.SEX, AVG(L.DNA) AS avg_dna, AVG(L.ALB - L.TP) AS avg_alb_minus_tp FROM Laboratory AS L INNER JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 180 GROUP BY P.SEX

assumptions.assumption: Laboratory.DNA is a TEXT-like/mixed column; AVG relies on SQLite's numeric coercion of its values (non-numeric text counts as 0), and NULLs are ignored.
AVG(ALB - TP) ignores rows where either ALB or TP is NULL, since the difference is NULL then; AVG returns NULL when no rows qualify.
Blank and NULL SEX values are each kept as their own groups by grouping on P.SEX directly (NULL forms one group, empty string another).
